1: // Simple Orbit Escape game with improved graphics
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   /*** Configuration ***/
6:   const CONFIG = {
7:     // ... (existing config unchanged)
8:   };
9: 
10:    // Audio setup using Web Audio API
11:    const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:    // Ensure audio context is resumed on first user interaction (required by browsers)
13:    const resumeAudio = () => { audioCtx.resume(); window.removeEventListener('click', resumeAudio); window.removeEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio); };
14:    window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
15:    window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
16:    function playTone(freq, duration = 0.1, type = 'sine') {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.type = type;
20:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
21:     osc.connect(gain);
22:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
25:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
27:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
28:   }
29: 
30:   // ... (rest of file unchanged)
31:     width: 800,
32:     height: 600,
33:     ship: {
34:       radius: 8,
35:       thrust: 0.08,
36:       rotationSpeed: 0.05,
37:       maxFuel: 100,
38:       fuelConsume: 0.3,
39:       fuelGain: 20,
40:     },
41:     orb: {
42:       radius: 5,
43:       count: 5,
44:     },
45:     asteroid: {
46:       radius: 12,
47:       speed: 1.2,
48:       spawnInterval: 3000,
49:     },
50:     gravity: 0.2, // simple central pull
51:     backgroundSpeed: 0.001,
52:   };
53: 
54:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
55:   if (!canvas) {
56:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
57:     return;
58:   }
59:   canvas.width = CONFIG.width;
60:   canvas.height = CONFIG.height;
61:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
62: 
63:   // Game state
64:   const ship = {
65:     x: CONFIG.width / 2,
66:     y: CONFIG.height / 2 - 150,
67:     vx: 0,
68:     vy: 0,
69:     angle: Math.PI / 2, // pointing upward
70:     fuel: CONFIG.ship.maxFuel,
71:     alive: true,
72:   };
73: 
74:   const orbs = [];
75:   const asteroids = [];
76:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
77:   let lastFrame = performance.now();
78:   let bgAngle = 0;
79: 
80:   function randRange(min, max) {
81:     return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
82:   }
83: 
84:   function spawnOrbs() {
85:     while (orbs.length < CONFIG.orb.count) {
86:       const angle = randRange(0, Math.PI * 2);
87:       const dist = randRange(80, 250);
88:       orbs.push({
89:         x: CONFIG.width / 2 + Math.cos(angle) * dist,
90:         y: CONFIG.height / 2 + Math.sin(angle) * dist,
91:         collected: false,
92:       });
93:     }
94:   }
95: 
96:   function spawnAsteroid() {
97:     const edge = Math.floor(randRange(0, 4)); // 0 top,1 right,2 bottom,3 left
98:     let x, y, vx, vy;
99:     const speed = CONFIG.asteroid.speed;
100:     switch (edge) {
101:       case 0:
102:         x = randRange(0, CONFIG.width);
103:         y = -CONFIG.asteroid.radius;
104:         break;
105:       case 1:
106:         x = CONFIG.width + CONFIG.asteroid.radius;
107:         y = randRange(0, CONFIG.height);
108:         break;
109:       case 2:
110:         x = randRange(0, CONFIG.width);
111:         y = CONFIG.height + CONFIG.asteroid.radius;
112:         break;
113:       case 3:
114:         x = -CONFIG.asteroid.radius;
115:         y = randRange(0, CONFIG.height);
116:         break;
117:     }
118:     // direction towards centre
119:     const dx = CONFIG.width / 2 - x;
120:     const dy = CONFIG.height / 2 - y;
121:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
122:     vx = (dx / len) * speed;
123:     vy = (dy / len) * speed;
124:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy });
125:   }
126: 
127:   function update(dt) {
128:     if (!ship.alive) return;
129:     // rotation
130:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= CONFIG.ship.rotationSpeed * dt;
131:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += CONFIG.ship.rotationSpeed * dt;
132:     // thrust
133:     if (keys.ArrowUp && ship.fuel > 0) {
134:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * CONFIG.ship.thrust * dt;
135:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * CONFIG.ship.thrust * dt;
136:       ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - CONFIG.ship.fuelConsume * dt);
137:       // generate thrust particles and sound
138:       for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) spawnParticle();
139:       playTone(400, 0.05, 'square'); // short thrust tone
140:     }
141:     // gravity toward centre
142:     const dx = CONFIG.width / 2 - ship.x;
143:     const dy = CONFIG.height / 2 - ship.y;
144:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
145:     const gx = (dx / dist) * CONFIG.gravity * dt;
146:     const gy = (dy / dist) * CONFIG.gravity * dt;
147:     ship.vx += gx;
148:     ship.vy += gy;
149:     // move ship
150:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
151:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
152:     // simple bounds wrap (prevent leaving canvas)
153:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = CONFIG.width;
154:     if (ship.x > CONFIG.width) ship.x = 0;
155:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = CONFIG.height;
156:     if (ship.y > CONFIG.height) ship.y = 0;
157:     // collect orbs
158:     for (const o of orbs) {
159:        if (!o.collected && Math.hypot(ship.x - o.x, ship.y - o.y) < CONFIG.ship.radius + CONFIG.orb.radius) {
160:          o.collected = true;
161:          ship.fuel = Math.min(CONFIG.ship.maxFuel, ship.fuel + CONFIG.ship.fuelGain);
162:          // play collection sound
163:          playTone(800, 0.07, 'triangle');
164:        }
165:     }
166:     // spawn new orbs if needed
167:     spawnOrbs();
168:     // asteroids update
169:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
170:       const a = asteroids[i];
171:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
172:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
173:       // collision with ship
174:         if (Math.hypot(ship.x - a.x, ship.y - a.y) < CONFIG.ship.radius + CONFIG.asteroid.radius) {
175:           ship.alive = false;
176:           // play collision sound
177:           playTone(200, 0.3, 'sawtooth');
178:         }
179:       // remove if passed centre
180:       const toCenter = Math.hypot(a.x - CONFIG.width / 2, a.y - CONFIG.height / 2);
181:       if (toCenter < 10) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
182:     }
183:     // asteroid spawn timer
184:     if (performance.now() - lastAsteroid > CONFIG.asteroid.spawnInterval) {
185:       spawnAsteroid();
186:       lastAsteroid = performance.now();
187:     }
188:     // background rotation
189:     bgAngle += CONFIG.backgroundSpeed * dt;
190:   }
191: 
192:   // Pre‑generated starfield for background
193: const stars = [];
194: for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
195:   stars.push({
196:     x: Math.random() * CONFIG.width,
197:     y: Math.random() * CONFIG.height,
198:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
199:     alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3,
200:   });
201: }
202: 
203: // Thrust particle pool
204: const particles = [];
205: function spawnParticle() {
206:   particles.push({
207:     x: ship.x,
208:     y: ship.y,
209:     vx: -Math.cos(ship.angle) * (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5) - ship.vx * 0.2,
210:     vy: -Math.sin(ship.angle) * (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5) - ship.vy * 0.2,
211:     life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
212:   });
213: }
214: 
215: function draw() {
216:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, CONFIG.width, CONFIG.height);
217:     // Starfield
218:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
219:     for (const s of stars) {
220:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
221:       ctx.beginPath();
222:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
223:       ctx.fill();
224:     }
225:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
226:     // rotating planet with gradient
227:     ctx.save();
228:     ctx.translate(CONFIG.width / 2, CONFIG.height / 2);
229:     ctx.rotate(bgAngle);
230:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 80, 0, 0, 200);
231:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#445');
232:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#001');
233:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
234:     ctx.beginPath();
235:     ctx.arc(0, 0, 200, 0, Math.PI * 2);
236:     ctx.fill();
237:     ctx.restore();
238:     // draw orbs with glow
239:     for (const o of orbs) {
240:       if (o.collected) continue;
241:       const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, CONFIG.orb.radius * 4);
242:       glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.8)');
243:       glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
244:       ctx.fillStyle = glow;
245:       ctx.beginPath();
246:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, CONFIG.orb.radius * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
247:       ctx.fill();
248:       ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
249:       ctx.beginPath();
250:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, CONFIG.orb.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
251:       ctx.fill();
252:     }
253:     // draw asteroids with simple shading
254:     for (const a of asteroids) {
255:       const aGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, 0, a.x, a.y, CONFIG.asteroid.radius);
256:       aGrad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
257:       aGrad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
258:       ctx.fillStyle = aGrad;
259:       ctx.beginPath();
260:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, CONFIG.asteroid.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
261:       ctx.fill();
262:     }
263:     // draw thrust particles
264:     ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
265:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
266:       const p = particles[i];
267:       p.x += p.vx;
268:       p.y += p.vy;
269:       p.life--;
270:       if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
271:       ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 50;
272:       ctx.beginPath();
273:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
274:       ctx.fill();
275:     }
276:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
277:     // draw ship with crisp shape
278:     if (ship.alive) {
279:       ctx.save();
280:       ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
281:       ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
282:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
283:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
284:       ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
285:       ctx.beginPath();
286:       ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
287:       ctx.lineTo(-8, -7);
288:       ctx.lineTo(-8, 7);
289:       ctx.closePath();
290:       ctx.fill();
291:       ctx.stroke();
292:       ctx.restore();
293:     }
294:     // fuel bar
295:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
296:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, (ship.fuel / CONFIG.ship.maxFuel) * 100, 8);
297:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'black';
298:     ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, 100, 8);
299:     if (!ship.alive) {
300:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
301:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
302:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', CONFIG.width / 2 - 80, CONFIG.height / 2);
303:     }
304:   }
305: 
306:   const keys = {};
307:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
308:     if (e.key in keys) return;
309:     keys[e.key] = true;
310:   });
311:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
312:     keys[e.key] = false;
313:   });
314: 
315:   function loop(timestamp) {
316:     const dt = (timestamp - lastFrame) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps steps
317:     lastFrame = timestamp;
318:     update(dt);
319:     draw();
320:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
321:   }
322: 
323:   // initialise
324:   spawnOrbs();
325:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
326: })();
